summary.name: Descript
summary.one_liner: Descript is an AI video and audio editor where you edit footage by editing its automatically generated transcript.
use_cases: edit videos by deleting words in a transcript
turn long recordings or podcasts into short social clips
remove background noise and enhance voice audio
generate missing B-roll or music for footage
produce marketing or support videos without a video team
summary.what_it_does: Descript transcribes uploaded video, audio, or recordings (including Zoom calls) so the user can cut, trim, and rearrange footage by editing the transcript; deleting a word removes the matching video. It offers a timeline for fine control. Its AI co-editor, Underlord, can produce a rough cut from raw footage based on instructions. Other features include one-click Studio Sound for noise removal and voice enhancement, clip creation for social formats, and generated video, voice, music, and images to fill gaps in footage. The page also lists enterprise controls such as SOC 2 Type II, SAML SSO and SCIM, and GDPR compliance.
notable: Edit video by editing its auto-generated transcript
Underlord AI co-editor for rough cuts and clips
Enterprise security: SOC 2 Type II, SAML SSO, SCIM, GDPR
caveats: Paid tiers exist; the free plan has limits that users may outgrow (page does not list specifics)
Enterprise security features are described for business use; specifics require a demo
